title: Whole-Book V2 Real Analysis Engine
user_summary: Adds the first structured, resumable Whole-Book V2 engine and formal seven-module frontend route while preserving V1 and the CHG-069 mock.
technical_summary: Introduces versioned Pydantic contracts, one-pass shared window primitives, normalization and evidence validation, provider-unit planning and pinning, JSON-asset persistence, formal versioned read APIs, progress state, and a typed frontend adapter.
acceptance_criteria: all seven formal modules are represented by structured versioned data
one shared extraction pass feeds synthesis without per-module rescans
evidence validates chapter identity, snapshot, revision and offsets
progress, provider pinning and resume-safe unit execution are explicit
V1 and the static V2 mock remain available
verification_evidence: Frontend targeted Vitest: 3 files / 9 tests passed

data_compatibility.notes: V2 materializes into existing versioned JSON assets and checkpoints; legacy results are explicitly unavailable/partial rather than promoted.

provider_impact.notes: Run provider/model are pinned; retry, repair and resume reject mismatches and never silently fall back.
